info.name: Create a chat completion with a Shape

items.docs: OpenAI-compatible chat completion. The `model` field selects the Shape as `shapesinc/<shape-username>`. Supports text plus a single `image_url` or `audio_url` content part. Streaming, system messages, message history, and parameter control (e.g. temperature) are not supported; personality and settings come from the Shape's shapes.inc configuration.
